$comment: Golden-frame poses (pesquisa-qualidade/a-visual.md §6, game/ART.md §9). status: 'exists' = captured through ?debug&pose=<runtimePose>; 'approx' = the nearest existing runtime pose stands in until the runtime can place the camera (see camera); 'needs-runtime' = not captured until the ?golden=1 hook (README) can place the camera, the avatar or the time of day. Coordinates are world units of the story map (Reserva da Iara, STORY_VERSION 1); camera.position/target are the eye and look-at point, fov the vertical field of view in degrees (CAMERA_FOV is 70). References are file names in ~/.cache/agents/2026-10-25-trilha-secreta/pesquisa-qualidade/referencias/ (copyrighted, never copied into the repo).

poses.name: Início da trilha
poses.notes: Spawn at the base, facing north-east along the trail; runtime chase camera.

poses.name: Clareira com forração
poses.notes: Mission 4 clearing (target 112, 118; six planting spots around it), seen from its south-west edge.

poses.name: Travessia do rio, do alto
poses.notes: Bridge from (50, 124) to (62, 134), deck about 2.1–2.3 u. Until the hook exists, the 'bridge' pose (chase camera at the west end) stands in; the target framing is from above, 12 u up.

poses.name: Borda do mapa olhando para fora
poses.notes: West limit, looking out (yaw −π/2). The void metric (lower half not covered by geometry) is the gate for this pose.

poses.name: Sob o dossel olhando para cima
poses.notes: North forest floor (44, 40), ground 1.39 u; camera pitched about 60° up into the canopy. Needs a free camera (pitch beyond the chase camera's limit).

poses.name: Avatar de perto, fundo verde
poses.notes: Full 3 u avatar on 1.4 u ground: target at torso centre, with head and feet in frame. Free camera, fov 50.

poses.name: Margem de perto
poses.notes: West bank of the stones pool (take-off 80.0, 66.1, water 2.02). The 'stones' pose (avatar at the take-off, facing the crossing) stands in until the hook can lower the camera onto the waterline.

poses.name: Obby na floresta
poses.covers: blocos e plataformas contra a mata
poses.notes: The six mirante ledges (121, 97) → (126.3, 72.4), tops 7.5–15, seen from behind the take-off pad (120.3, 6, 100.3).

poses.name: Início da trilha à noite
poses.notes: P1 with the night light rig; the runtime has no night variant yet (?golden=1&time=night).

poses.name: Lineup
poses.notes: WebGL lineup page (assets in a row next to the avatar and a scale bar, standard light), the counterpart of scripts/blender/lineup.py. Not part of the game runtime yet.

poses.name: Topo do mirante (extra)
poses.notes: Not one of the ten; captured because the runtime has it and the canopy framing there is a known issue (p5-map-runtime-codex.md).

poses.name: Mirante olhando para a baixada com zoom aberto
poses.covers: far-plane clipping, terrain y bounds and distant reserve
poses.notes: Owner void regression: elevated camera above the mirante ledges looking down across the lowland. Low far=70 clips the floor; far field must cover the lower frame.
